nodes.description: Token symbol string state variable, set to NCO in the constructor.
Token name string state variable, set to NoneCoin in the constructor.
Token decimals state variable, set to 18 in the constructor.
Total token supply state variable assigned in the constructor and read by totalSupply().
mapping(address => uint) of token balances; read and written by transfer, transferFrom, balanceOf and totalSupply.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) of allowances; written by approve and approveAndCall, read by transferFrom and allowance.
Owner address set to msg.sender in the Owned constructor and read by the onlyOwner modifier.
Pending owner address written by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership.
Pure helper performing a + b with a require(c >= a) overflow guard.
Pure helper performing a - b with a require(b <= a) underflow guard.
Pure helper performing a * b with an overflow check require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
Pure helper performing a / b guarded by require(b > 0).
Owned constructor assigning owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner function setting newOwner to the supplied address.
Requires msg.sender == newOwner then transfers ownership and resets newOwner.
NCO constructor that initialises symbol, name, decimals, _totalSupply and the initial balance mapping entry.
Returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] using an unchecked subtraction.
Constant function returning balances[tokenOwner].
Transfers tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd and emits Transfer.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
Spends allowance allowed[from][msg.sender] and moves balances[from] to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd.
Constant function returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Approves spender then performs an external callback to spender.receiveApproval with msg.sender, tokens, this and data.
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts.
onlyOwner function performing an external call to an arbitrary token contract transferring tokens to owner.
msg.sender, the externally controlled caller used for ownership, balances and allowance accounting.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) made to an attacker-supplied contract after state has been updated.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to an arbitrary caller-supplied contract address.
Unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] which can underflow.
Addition c = a + b in safeAdd that relies on the require(c >= a) guard.
Subtraction c = a - b in safeSub guarded by require(b <= a).
Multiplication c = a * b in safeMul guarded by require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
Division c = a / b in safeDiv guarded by require(b > 0).

edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns msg.sender to the owner state variable.
onlyOwner modifier on transferOwnership requires msg.sender == owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before transferring ownership.
transfer debits and credits balances using msg.sender as the sender.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom spends allowed[from][msg.sender] of the caller.
approveAndCall approves from msg.sender and forwards msg.sender into the external callback.
onlyOwner on transferAnyERC20Token checks msg.sender against owner.
transferOwnership reads the owner state variable through the onlyOwner check.
transferAnyERC20Token reads owner both for the onlyOwner check and as the transfer recipient.
acceptOwnership reads newOwner for the equality check and then clears it.
transferOwnership writes the pending newOwner state variable.
acceptOwnership assigns newOwner into the owner state variable.
totalSupply returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] in its return expression.
balanceOf returns the balances mapping entry for tokenOwner.
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping for sender and recipient.
transferFrom reads and writes balances for the from and to accounts.
approve writes the allowed allowance mapping.
transferFrom decreases and reads the allowed allowance mapping.
allowance returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall writes the allowed mapping before the external call.
NCO constructor sets symbol.
NCO constructor sets name.
NCO constructor sets decimals.
NCO constructor sets _totalSupply.
NCO constructor credits the initial holder balance in the balances mapping.
transfer calls safeSub to debit the sender balance.
transfer calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transferFrom calls safeSub for the balance and allowance debits.
transferFrom calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
safeAdd performs the guarded addition c = a + b.
safeSub performs the guarded subtraction c = a - b.
safeMul performs the guarded multiplication c = a * b.
safeDiv performs the guarded division c = a / b.
totalSupply performs an unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] that can underflow.
approveAndCall executes an external call into the caller-supplied spender contract after updating allowed, enabling reentrancy.
transferAnyERC20Token executes an external call into an arbitrary token contract held by the owner.

_newOwner parameter is written into newOwner by transferOwnership.

to parameter indexes the balances mapping in transfer.
tokens parameter is the amount moved by transfer.

tokens parameter is the allowance value set by approve.

to parameter is the recipient index in transferFrom.
tokens parameter is the amount moved by transferFrom.
tokenOwner parameter indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
spender parameter indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
spender parameter indexes allowed and is the target of the external callback in approveAndCall.
tokens parameter is the approved amount in approveAndCall.
data parameter is forwarded into the receiveApproval external call.
tokenAddress parameter is the external contract called by transferAnyERC20Token.
tokens parameter is the amount passed to the external transfer call.
